text: 1.Program Overview The graduates will have solid foundation for specialty knowledge and have creative ability to fulfill the requirement of engineering practice in the future. After the training of fundamental principles and knowledge in the discipline of civil engineering as a qualified engineering, the graduates will be cultivated to be competent for the professional position such as construction, structural design, engineering investigation, management, engineering consulting, education, research and development in the engineering fields of civil architecture, highway, bridge, tunnel as well as railway. 2.Teaching Objectives Be equipped the knowledge of Civil engineering discipline and professional training experience for engineers; Qualified ability for the work of planning, design, construction, management and research in civil engineering projects. 3.Main Courses Advanced Math, Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Building materials, Material Mechanics, Structural Mechanics, Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering, Concrete Structure, Steel Structure, and Architecture Construction,Elementary Chinese, Survey of China, Intermediate Chinese 4.Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. 5.Duration 4 Years 6.Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted BachelorDegree of Civil EngineeringbyNortheastern University 7.Future Career You will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies.
